title: Fourier polynomial of the middle layer
statement: For every natural number $m$, the Fourier polynomial of the indicator of the middle layer in the sign cube of dimension $2m$ equals the binomial polynomial $\sum_{j=0}^{m}(-1)^j\binom{m}{j}X^{2j}$ multiplied by the constant polynomial with value $\binom{2m}{m}/2^{2m}$.
